GTA 6 hits $3.79 billion in its first day on sale, becoming "the biggest entertainment launch in history"

Rockstar has announced that GTA 6 achieved $3.79 billion in retail sales in its first day on sale, "setting a new record for entertainment across any medium, and becoming the biggest entertainment launch in history."

Ampere Analysis: Over 2m UK and US Xbox players accessed GTA 6 before official launch by switching location to New Zealand

Over two million Xbox players in the UK and US accessed Grand Theft Auto 6 before its official launch by changing their location to New Zealand, according to Ampere Analysis.

text:
GTA 6: the first billion-dollar game may also be the last | Opinion

What does a billion dollars look like on screen? Or $1.5bn, or perhaps $2bn; estimates swing around a little for just how much money has been spent creating GTA 6. The one thing that’s certain is that it’s the most expensive game ever made – in fact, by far the most expensive piece of media ever made.

Sensor Tower estimates GTA 6 generated $2.36bn in pre-order and launch-day sales

Sensor Tower estimates Grand Theft Auto 6 sold over 24.5 million copies through pre-orders and on launch day, generating approximately $2.36 billion in revenue.

author: GamesIndustry.biz
text:
How the EU's Digital Fairness Act will impact game design, and why it hits European indies particularly hard

The European Commission's publication of its draft Digital Fairness Act (DFA) last week prompted uproar within the games industry, with many notable voices candidly expressing their concerns. Opinions in the wider industry were more measured, possibly because some of the practices targeted by the DFA – such as loot boxes or pay-to-win – are wildly successful economically, but not uniformly popular amongst players.

author: GamesIndustry.biz
text:
The creator of E.T. on the Atari 2600 likens the deluge of AI-made games to the glut of poor-quality titles released ahead of the US video game crash of 1983

At the DevGAMM Lisbon conference this week, veteran game designer Howard Scott Warshaw gave a talk called "From Atari to AI". Warshaw was behind a number of famous titles for the Atari 2600, including the classic Yars' Revenge, but infamously he also designed the game E.T. the Extra-Terrestial, the poor quality of which has been cited as a factor in the US video game crash of 1983, when US games industry revenue plummeted from over $3 billion in 1983 to around $100 million in 1985.

text:
IGN partners with Rockstar to host Official Strategy Guide for GTA 6

IGN Entertainment, the parent company of GamesIndustry.biz, has released the Official Online Guide for GTA 6, created through direct collaboration with Rockstar Games. The free guide, which was published on IGN.com, includes an extensive interactive map built using the firm's MapGenie platform, along with checklist trackers for completed tasks and detailed guides on missions, mechanics, and the game's vast open world.
